verdict.rationale: Ollama's own site states the capability almost verbatim: dedicated capacity so throughput holds up when running several agents at once. Its pricing page adds that plans run multiple models concurrently, which places this in the cloud offering. The evidence is a single marketing line plus a pricing bullet. missing for 10: technical documentation of how capacity is reserved (limits, concurrency caps, which tiers include it), any throughput figures under concurrent load, independent or hands-on corroboration that throughput stays steady across concurrent sessions.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the runtime reserves dedicated capacity so throughput holds steady when multiple agents or sessions issue requests concurrently

citations.quote: Dedicated capacity so throughput holds up when you are running several agents at once.
